entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Extensions: consider adjusting receiver requirements for extension members #79451
  • Static extension members for `enum` type are not part of IntelliSense #79444
  • No IntelliSense in lambda body of ternary consequent expression when ternary alternative expression is missing or invalid #79443
  • Extensions: follow-ups related to `using` directives #79440
  • `CS0177` is not reported on method with unassigned `out` parameter when calling `extern` local function #79437
  • Invalid order of evaluation for compound assignment involving expanded param array form #79436

Closed

  • A possible ref safety "hole" around UnscopedRef method invoked on an expression classified as a value or readonly variable of a struct type #67435

    Backlog
